entries.what: Walks the 12 minutes down Vinca to Flats High for first through sixth period, then sits in Ms. Tolentino's third-period chemistry with Karina at their lab bench.
entries.outcome: Got through the day, lunch in room B12 with Karina and Eli.

entries.what: After school she texts Karina about a lab question and sees it marked seen with no reply for two hours, so she stews and spirals about whether Karina is mad.
entries.outcome: Karina finally answered that she was just doing homework; Dulce felt silly but still uneasy.

entries.what: Evening at home in unit 114 with her mom Yesenia, who is back from her day shift at St. Anselm; they eat dinner and Dulce finishes geometry.
entries.outcome: Asleep around 11:30 after scrolling.

entries.what: Regular school day: geometry, English, chemistry, history, PE in the last volleyball weeks, and Spanish for heritage speakers. Lunch in B12 with Karina and Eli.
entries.outcome: Eli shared his chem notes again.

entries.what: Walks home and does homework at the kitchen table, working the chem problem set in minutes.
entries.outcome: Math done fast; the lab conclusion is left for later.

entries.what: Group-chat banter in 'lab rats' with Karina and Eli, mostly memes, then bed.
entries.outcome: Laughed a lot, slept a bit late.

entries.what: School day, with lunch in B12 and chemistry third period with Ms. Tolentino.
entries.outcome: Turned in the problem set without trouble.

entries.what: Yesenia mentions the city council candidate forum at the community center tonight and the Measure K arguments; Dulce skips it and stays home with homework.
entries.outcome: Stayed home while her mom listened to the forum talk on the phone.

entries.what: Orders a taro slush at Cloud Nine only for herself after school and counts out her money.
entries.outcome: Spent $6 instead of buying for everyone.

entries.what: School day, then home to change before heading to the family pupusa stand on Thursday evening.
entries.outcome: Caught a ride with her mom to the stand.

entries.what: Starts helping at Pupusería Henríquez, folding to-go boxes beside Tía Gladys, and asks for tips to fold them faster so Gladys does not have to redo them.
entries.outcome: Gladys showed her a quicker fold; Dulce's got the hang of it by the end.

entries.what: Rafael drives her home after the stand closes, and they split a pupusa on the way.
entries.outcome: Home before bedtime.

entries.what: School day, with chemistry and lunch in B12; payday is today so she is watching the clock for the afternoon.
entries.outcome: Made it through the day.

entries.what: With her mom she sets up the teen checking account for direct deposit, replacing the paper check she used to cash at the market, and writes the account number on a sticky note in her wallet.
entries.outcome: Direct deposit is now how she gets paid every other Friday.

entries.what: Works her 4-9 shift at Taquería Colima, takes orders and counts the drawer, and pays Camila back the $20 she owed for covering the Sunday shift.
entries.outcome: Debt cleared; Efraín gave her a quesadilla plate.

entries.what: Rafael picks her up at the 9 p.m. close and drives her home.
entries.outcome: Home by 9:30.

entries.what: Saturday laundry at the card-only laundry room, loading the machines with her mom's help.
entries.outcome: Laundry folded by noon.

entries.what: Spends the afternoon with friends from the new crew, mostly texting and watching videos, and works on an edit she never posts.
entries.outcome: Another edit finished and saved in drafts.

entries.what: Stays in with her mom for dinner and a movie.
entries.outcome: Early night.

entries.what: Works the Sunday 10-4 shift at Taquería Colima taking orders on the lunch rush.
entries.outcome: Busy shift, no mistakes on tickets.

entries.what: Takes the 22 bus home from Calle Ortega and eats leftovers at home.
entries.outcome: Home by early evening.

entries.what: Does a bit of homework and chats with Karina, who texts after midnight again.
entries.outcome: Reassured Karina and fell asleep late.
